issues.description: The raised guards have no specified height, opening limits, or changing-pad retention. The factory cannot verify that the changing surface prevents falls or entrapment.
issues.fix: Specify guard geometry, allowable gaps, pad retention, and the target-market safety tests before tooling.
issues.rule_citation: Changing-unit safety requirements — EN 12221-1; baby changing product safety requirements — ASTM F2388.

issues.description: The anti-tip kit is listed, but wall type, anchor selection, and installation instructions are unspecified. An unsuitable anchor could leave the assembled table unstable.
issues.fix: Specify compatible wall substrates and anchors, installation instructions, and stability verification for the assembled product.
issues.rule_citation: Stability and installation safety requirements — EN 12221-1; ASTM F2388.

issues.description: The part tolerance conflicts with the tighter CNC-panel and fitting-hole tolerances. Flat-pack joints also lack defined mating clearances and allowance for lacquer buildup.
issues.fix: Issue dimensioned drawings that identify controlling tolerances, joint clearances, and dimensions to inspect after finishing.
issues.rule_citation: Define functional dimensions and tolerance stack-ups at mating features — ISO 2768 general tolerances apply only where individual tolerances are not indicated.

issues.description: The generic fastener set does not define joint locations, edge distances, or assembly access. Plywood joints may split or loosen under repeated use.
issues.fix: Specify fastener type, pilot holes, edge distances, assembly sequence, and joint-strength testing on production plywood.
issues.rule_citation: Structural integrity requirements for changing units — EN 12221-1; ASTM F2388.

issues.description: Satin lacquer is assigned to the foam pad, although the pad calls for a wipe-clean cover. The cover material, seam construction, and cleaning-agent resistance are undefined.
issues.fix: Remove the lacquer finish from the pad specification and define the cover, sealed seams, approved cleaners, and durability test.
issues.rule_citation: Material and product durability must be specified for intended cleaning and use — ASTM F2388 baby changing product safety specification.

issues.description: The guard material is left as plywood or HPL, without a specified substrate, edge construction, or bonding method. The options need different fabrication and finishing instructions.
issues.fix: Select one construction and specify laminate thickness, adhesive, exposed-edge treatment, and inspection criteria.
issues.rule_citation: Material and construction must be defined for reproducible manufacture — ISO 9001:2015, clause 8.5.1.

issues.description: Solid product (51.8 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: CNC routing of plywood sheet + edge finishing + flat-pack assembly.
issues.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
issues.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

assembly_notes: Assemble on a flat fixture; verify overall dimensions, squareness, and stable contact with the floor.

Fit the changing pad and confirm it lies flat and cannot shift during normal use.

issues.description: Solid product (51.8 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: CNC routing of plywood sheet + edge finishing + flat-pack assembly.
issues.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
issues.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Solid volume of all parts, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Largest panel 900 × 560 mm fits a 2440 × 1220 mm plywood sheet; nest all panels on as few sheets as possible.
issues.fix: Nest the CNC programme on full sheets; grain along the longest side.

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Largest panel length, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Thinnest wooden part 16 mm: OK for screws and cam locks.
issues.fix: Keep structural panels ≥ 15 mm (18 mm birch ply); round every accessible edge r ≥ 2 mm (child safety).
issues.rule_citation: Cam-lock fittings need ≥ 15 mm board; EN 12221 asks for rounded accessible edges — Estimate

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Smallest extent of the wooden parts, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: The part tolerance conflicts with the tighter CNC-panel tolerance, leaving suppliers unsure which controls routed dimensions.
issues.fix: Issue a drawing with one tolerance for routed profiles and explicit tolerances for mating features and holes.
issues.rule_citation: Use unambiguous dimensional tolerances on drawings — ISO 129-1; general tolerances — ISO 2768-1.

issues.description: The fastener set has no specified joint design, hole pattern, or assembly sequence, so the factory cannot verify alignment or repeatable assembly.
issues.fix: Provide joint details, fastener specifications, pilot-hole locations, and assembly drawings; prototype and load-test the assembled unit.
issues.rule_citation: Changing-unit structural performance and stability requirements — EN 12221-1.

issues.description: The anti-tip kit does not specify compatible wall substrates or installation instructions, risking an ineffective installation.
issues.fix: Specify approved wall types, anchors for each type, attachment points, and installation and inspection instructions.
issues.rule_citation: Changing-unit stability and instructions for use — EN 12221-1 and EN 12221-2.

issues.description: Guard geometry and joints lack defined safety acceptance criteria; their ability to contain the pad and withstand use cannot be verified for production.
issues.fix: Dimension the guards and openings, define joint strength and inspection criteria, and test a production-intent assembly.
issues.rule_citation: Changing-unit safety requirements and test methods — EN 12221-1.

issues.description: Satin lacquer is specified as the foam pad finish, conflicting with its wipe-clean cover construction.
issues.fix: Remove lacquer from the pad specification and define the cover material, seam construction, and cleaning-chemical resistance.
issues.rule_citation: Specify material and finish appropriate to the manufacturing process and intended use — ISO 9001:2015, clause 8.3.5.

issues.description: The guard material is left as plywood or HPL, but those options require different edge construction and finishing.
issues.fix: Select a guard construction and specify laminate thickness, bonding method, exposed-edge treatment, and compatible lacquer application.
issues.rule_citation: Define material and finish requirements in design outputs — ISO 9001:2015, clause 8.3.5.

assembly_notes: Assemble on a flat fixture; verify overall dimensions, squareness, and stable contact with the floor.
Use specified fasteners and pilot holes to avoid splitting plywood; tighten securely without crushing panels.
Check guard-rail attachment, gaps, edges, and all accessible surfaces for sharp points or splinters.
Fit the changing pad and confirm it lies flat and cannot shift during normal use.
No electronics or battery are specified; burn-in and battery-shipping procedures are not applicable.
